Add Class A maintenance tasks to annual calendar.

Schedule a refresher session for all current staff within 60 days.
Record completions in personnel file.

Identify a backup applicator candidate from current crew or future hires.
Coordinate state IL applicator exam scheduling and study materials.
Maintain certification renewals on training calendar.

Submit DoD pesticide applicator paperwork through installation bio-environmental office.
File license copies with MWR and post in pesticide storage area.
Track renewal date on calendar.
entries.notes: Blocks 1.3.9, the back-nine moss treatment, and pest management plan execution.

Submit MWR training request for off-site conferences with travel funding.

Cross-train mechanic on diesel systems given fleet composition.

entries.standard_text: Practice bunker

entries.target_state: A dedicated practice bunker constructed near the putting/chipping green complex.

Design a small bunker (50-150 sq ft) with proper drainage and bunker sand spec.
Build via in-house crew + materials purchase OR contracted small-scope construction.
Add to maintenance rotation (groomed 3x/week per 2.2.7).

entries.standard_text: Starter is used during peak play times and has a designated location (building, cart, kiosk, etc.) from which duties are performed

Build a simple starter sign and weather cover if outdoor.
Schedule starter coverage for peak weekend and tournament hours.
Update SOP (5.1.1) to include starter duties and check-in flow.

Coordinate dates with GCM to minimize patron disruption (5.1.32).
Procure aerifier (rental or purchase - see 4.1.15) ahead of fall window.
Log all events into maintenance records (5.1.37).

actions: Submit work order to clean, stain, repaint, and re-spike existing markers.
Identify markers beyond repair; submit PR for replacements.
Establish quarterly tee marker inspection on calendar.

entries.standard_text: Cart paths are weed free at all times

Buy or use existing string trimmer + backpack sprayer with appropriate herbicide.
Document treatments in chemical log (5.1.37).

Use existing blower equipment.
Assign as part of cart-path inspection rotation.

Procure cold-patch asphalt + crack filler + sealer.

Quarterly inspection cycle to catch new damage early.

Schedule weekly deep-clean rotation.

entries.short_title: Inoperative equipment fixed within 2 business days
entries.standard_text: Action is taken to repair/replace inoperative equipment within 2 business days
entries.current_state: Equipment that goes inoperative is not consistently repaired or replaced within 2 business days, especially diesel equipment requiring outside vendor.
entries.target_state: PM and standing-stock setup that allows in-house fix within 2 business days for most failures.
actions: Build standing PR for high-failure consumables (belts, filters, hoses, bedknives, batteries).
Establish standing service contract with a diesel vendor (per Master Plan).
Mechanic cross-training on diesel (1.3.22).
PM schedule (5.1.40) to catch failures pre-breakdown.

entries.short_title: Current SOPs on file and accessible
entries.standard_text: Current Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are on file and are accessible to all Golf  staff members which include:
entries.current_state: Current SOPs are not all on file or accessible to all staff (opening/closing, tee time, rates, severe weather, rain check, tournament checklist, emergency, contacts, org chart).
entries.target_state: Full SOP binder (paper + digital) accessible to all staff; each section current.
actions: Start from existing SOPS-SUMMARY.txt in greenkeeper-pro app.
Build/update each required SOP section.
Publish to shared drive + print binder for golf shop and maintenance facility.
Annual review cycle.

entries.standard_text: Program expenses are tracked and meet budgetary goals
entries.current_state: Program expenses are tracked but not yet meeting budgetary goals (revenue gap per Master Plan).
entries.target_state: Expenses tracked vs budget monthly; corrective action when variance exceeds threshold.
actions: Monthly budget review meeting with MWR financial officer.
Track variance by category (labor, supplies, equipment, F&B COGS, etc.).
Tie expense reduction or revenue growth actions to plan items.

entries.standard_text: Manager has access to SAP via their own log-in and can demonstrate the ability to review financial statements including the capability of drilling down to mine additional data
entries.current_state: Manager does not have SAP access via own login or cannot demonstrate drill-down capability.
entries.target_state: GCM has full SAP access with documented training on drill-down for review.
actions: Request SAP account for GCM through MWR / N9 finance.
Complete SAP training.
Schedule monthly self-review of financial statements.

entries.standard_text: A Golf Advisory Board has been established, is comprised of a cross section of authorized patrons and operates under the guidance of CNICINST 1710.3
entries.current_state: No Golf Advisory Board currently established.
entries.target_state: Active board with cross-section of patrons operating per CNICINST 1710.3.
actions: Identify patron representatives (active duty, retiree, civilian, women's group, junior).
Draft board charter aligned with CNICINST 1710.3.
Schedule quarterly meetings.
Use board feedback to inform program decisions.

entries.standard_text: Publicity efforts are targeted at non peak times
entries.current_state: Publicity efforts are not targeted at non-peak times.
entries.target_state: Marketing calendar promotes twilight, off-season, weekday play to drive utilization.
actions: Build marketing calendar with non-peak focus blocks.
Use base channels for twilight specials, weekday discounts.
Track results month over month.

entries.short_title: Customer feedback answered within 2 business days
entries.standard_text: Customer feedback is answered within two business days of the Golf Course Manager/Head Golf Professional's receipt/notification
entries.current_state: Customer feedback is not consistently answered within 2 business days.
entries.target_state: Process ensures every feedback item gets acknowledged within 2 business days.
actions: Centralize feedback channel (email, comment card, ICE).
Daily check during opening; assign owner.
Track response time in log.

entries.standard_text: Each Golf employee has a current Individual Development Plan (IDP) which is actively utilized
entries.current_state: Status not marked on questionnaire - confirm whether each employee has a current IDP actively utilized.
entries.target_state: Every employee has a current IDP reviewed annually.
actions: Confirm status with each employee.
If absent, draft IDP for each role with development objectives.
Annual review built into employee performance cycle.
entries.notes: BLANK on questionnaire - confirm before final scoring.

entries.standard_text: All outdoor staff wear a uniform shirt with the word "staff" and displays the local golf logo on the left chest
entries.current_state: Outdoor staff do not wear uniform shirts with 'staff' and local golf logo.
entries.target_state: All outdoor staff in uniform shirt with 'staff' word + golf logo on left chest.
actions: Design uniform shirt with MWR / golf logo.
Submit PR for initial uniform stock (2-3 shirts per staff member).
Add to new-hire issued kit.

entries.standard_text: Maintenance staff wear a uniform top (jacket or shirt)
entries.current_state: Maintenance staff do not have uniform jackets or shirts.
entries.target_state: All maintenance staff issued uniform tops (work shirt, jacket).
actions: Combined with 5.1.18 / 5.1.20 - common uniform program.
PR for maintenance work shirts (heavyweight) + light jackets.

entries.standard_text: All staff members are provided staff uniform tops
entries.current_state: Not all staff are currently provided uniform tops.
entries.target_state: Standard: every staff member issued 2-3 uniform tops at start, replaced as needed.
actions: Combined program with 5.1.18 / 5.1.19.
Document uniform issuance in personnel file.

entries.standard_text: Golf Course Superintendent is involved in the development of the annual budget
entries.current_state: Superintendent is not yet formally involved in annual budget development.
entries.target_state: Superintendent provides input on maintenance budget, capital requests, and chemical/fertilizer line items each fiscal cycle.
actions: Establish formal budget meeting with MWR / GCM annually.
Build maintenance budget worksheet linked to course operations.
Submit capital requests aligned with 4.2.1 plan.

entries.standard_text: Golf  program has a theft prevention plan
entries.current_state: No documented theft prevention plan in place.
entries.target_state: Written plan covering merchandise, cash, equipment, and chemicals.
actions: Draft plan: inventory controls, cash handling, end-of-day procedures, alarm/lock check.
Train staff on plan elements.
Annual review with MWR security POC.

entries.short_title: Golf shop staff wear shop-representative uniforms
entries.standard_text: Golf shop staff wear uniforms representative of clothing sold in the shop
entries.current_state: Golf shop staff do not currently wear uniforms representative of clothing sold in the shop.
entries.target_state: Shop staff wear apparel that mirrors merchandise (e.g., shop brands like FootJoy / Travis Mathew / etc.).
actions: Once shop merchandise (3.2.11) is stocked, allocate staff uniform pieces from current line.
Quarterly refresh as new lines come in.

entries.standard_text: A merchandise reduction plan is in place
entries.current_state: No merchandise reduction plan in place (markdowns, clearance).
entries.target_state: Written reduction plan: aging schedule, markdown levels, end-of-season clearance.
actions: Adopt standard 90/120/180 day aging buckets.
Markdown schedule: 20%, 40%, 60%.
End-of-season blowout sale.
Track inventory turn (5.2.9).

entries.short_title: GCM and Superintendent coordinate annual schedule
entries.standard_text: Golf Course Manager/Head Golf Professional and the superintendent coordinate an annual activity schedule in advance to minimize disruption of programmed golf activities due to grounds maintenance
entries.current_state: No annual activity schedule coordinated between GCM and Superintendent.
entries.target_state: Joint calendar showing maintenance activities + golf events; aligned to minimize disruption.
actions: Quarterly planning meeting between GCM and Superintendent.
Build a single shared calendar showing both maintenance and events.
Adjust mowing, aeration, chemical apps around major events.

entries.standard_text: A pest management plan is in place to control diseases and insects
entries.current_state: No formal written pest management plan; treatments currently reactive.
entries.target_state: Documented IPM plan: pest scouting schedule, threshold-based treatment, chemical rotation, recordkeeping.
actions: Draft IPM plan covering insects (grubs, ABW), diseases (dollar spot, brown patch, snow mold), weeds.
Set scouting schedule by season.
Document chemical rotation and resistance management.
File with bio-environmental office.

entries.standard_text: The golf course superintendent maintains accurate, up-to-date maintenance records which include cost, type and name of materials, work history, problem areas and improvement projects/procedures in the following areas:
entries.current_state: Maintenance records do not consistently cover all required categories (fertilization, chemicals, soil tests, mowing/cultivation, training, work schedules, equipment, facilities, water quality, water usage, weather data).
entries.target_state: Complete records across all 11 categories; reviewable for audit.
actions: Use greenkeeper-pro app sections for each category.
Build a daily/weekly logging routine.
Quarterly audit of recordkeeping completeness.

entries.standard_text: An emergency response plan designed to deal with a chemical spill or fire or other emergencies (e.g. injuries) is posted and taught to all employees
entries.current_state: Status not marked on questionnaire - confirm whether emergency response plan (chemical spill, fire, injuries) is posted and taught.
entries.target_state: Plan posted in maintenance facility and golf shop; trained to all employees annually.
actions: Draft or update emergency response plan.
Post in maintenance and clubhouse.
Train all staff during onboarding and annual refresher.
entries.notes: BLANK on questionnaire - confirm before final scoring.

entries.standard_text: A preventive maintenance schedule has been established and followed for each piece of maintenance equipment
entries.current_state: No preventive maintenance schedule established for each piece of equipment.
entries.target_state: Documented PM schedule for each piece - intervals based on hours / season / OEM recommendations.
actions: Build PM matrix from FY26 asset inventory.
Set intervals (oil/filter, blade sharpening, hydraulic, electrical).
Use greenkeeper-pro equipment module to track.
Mechanic owns daily/weekly execution.

entries.short_title: 5% net profit including F&B and depreciation
entries.standard_text: Course is operating at a minimum 5% net profit (including food and beverage and depreciation)
entries.current_state: Course is not currently operating at 5%+ net profit.
entries.target_state: 5%+ net profit after F&B and depreciation, driven by revenue growth + cost discipline.
actions: Drive revenue: tournament calendar, lessons, memberships, range program, beverage cart.
Maintain cost discipline: COGS, labor %, equipment lifecycle.
Quarterly P&L review with leadership.
Outcome of executing most other Section 3 / Section 5 plan items.

entries.standard_text: Resale Cost of Goods Sold does not exceed benchmark standard (CNICINST 1710.3)
entries.current_state: Food resale COGS does not currently meet CNICINST 1710.3 benchmark.
entries.target_state: Food COGS within published benchmark.
actions: Audit current COGS by category.
Negotiate vendor pricing; consolidate purchases.
Adjust menu pricing where margin is thin.
Reduce waste through inventory discipline.

entries.standard_text: Weekly labor percentage does not exceed benchmark standard (CNICINST 1710.3)
entries.current_state: Food weekly labor percentage exceeds CNICINST 1710.3 benchmark.
entries.target_state: Labor % within benchmark via scheduling discipline.
actions: Match labor hours to expected revenue patterns.
Cross-train staff for flexibility.
Review schedule weekly.

entries.standard_text: Resale Cost of Goods Sold does not exceed benchmark standard (CNICINST 1710.3)
entries.current_state: Beverage resale COGS exceeds CNICINST 1710.3 benchmark.
entries.target_state: Within benchmark.
actions: Audit beverage COGS; renegotiate distributor pricing.
Pricing review on slow-moving beverages.
Tighten inventory controls.

entries.standard_text: Weekly labor percentage does not exceed benchmark standard (CNICINST 1710.3)
entries.current_state: Beverage weekly labor % exceeds CNICINST 1710.3 benchmark.
entries.target_state: Within benchmark.
actions: Schedule beverage cart and bar staffing to demand patterns.
Cross-train with food side.

entries.standard_text: Annual COGS percentage does not exceed 75%
entries.current_state: Golf shop annual COGS exceeds 75%.
entries.target_state: COGS at or below 75% through pricing and product mix discipline.
actions: Annual margin review by product category.
Drop low-margin SKUs.
Negotiate vendor terms (volume, terms, demo support).
